ID: Level ID = chapter number * 1000 + number of level X
DelayTime:
Delayed opening time
After clearing the previous level, the next level can be unlocked after +n days (UTC time)
ConfigID:
Configuration ID
Corresponds to the last 1/2 digits of the script file name
For example: StoryMode01 --- 1
DefaultShow:
Default action

Animator: The name of the state machine
AnimationShowPath:
